{{Quote|We had one of the bomb conspirators in our grasp today, but before I managed to question her, she was poisoned. She was under guard the entire time. I don't see how an assassin was able to get to her so quickly.|Ta'a Chume|<ref name="Lightsabers">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]''</ref>}}
In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], an '''assassin''' [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] a [[Unidentified bomb conspirator|bomb conspirator]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]]. The conspirator had taken part in the attempt to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the [[Hapan]] [[Matriarch/Legends|matriarch]], [[Ta'a Chume]], and her granddaughter, [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], by [[Bombing of Fountain Palace|bombing]] the residence of the [[Queen Mother]] of Hapes, [[Fountain Palace]]. However, no one was killed by the [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]], and the conspirator was caught. She was then put under guard and poisoned by the assassin before she could be questioned.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==Behind the scenes==
The assassin was mentioned in the young reader's novel ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]'' by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]], which was published in [[1996]].<ref name="Lightsabers" />
